# Dubbaka Sathwik

> Student • Full-Stack Developer • Creative Designer | Computer Science and Information Technology at MVSR Engineering College • Hyderabad, Telangana, India.

https://dubbakasathwik.in/ is the **official personal portfolio website of Dubbaka Sathwik** (also known as Sathwik Dubbaka, Dubbaka Sathwik Portfolio, DubbakaSathwik, dubbakasathwikio, Sathwik).

- [News Without the Noise](https://dubbakasathwik.in/projects/news-without-the-noise): News Without the Noise is an AI-powered personalized news ecosystem that dynamically filters misinformation, rage-bait, and sensationalism to deliver clean, trustworthy, and…
- [AI Hiring Assistant](https://dubbakasathwik.in/projects/ai-hiring-assistant): AI Hiring Assistant is a full-stack web application that uses OCR to extract text from candidate certificates and leverages LLaMA 3.1 to perform fraud analysis and ranking.
- [VaultFlow](https://dubbakasathwik.in/projects/vaultflow): VaultFlow is a local Android personal finance application built using Jetpack Compose. The app features secure offline database storage, receipt scanning, and smart budgeting…
